sources: doc=.ok-planner/CLAUDE.md (@story annotation convention: 'this site is load-bearing for delivering the story's user-observable outcome'); code=test/scenarios/all_upstream_gating_test.go (grep confirms zero @story: all-upstream-gating annotations; 38 other scenario test files in the same directory do carry @story tags per convention)

Only the @story: all-upstream-gating citation is missing at the proof site, a real gap against the repo-wide annotation convention, not a story-prose defect. Queue as a code-side annotation add.

sources: dossier=api-key ('Plaintext is surfaced exactly once', rk_ prefix, 2026-05-15+2026-06-08 artifacts), anonymous-mode; code=plaintext.go:18 (Prefix='rk_'); test=anonymous_mode_bootstrap_e2e_test.go:65 (greps 'rim_')
note: Story acceptance ('plaintext returned exactly once') is correct per dossier. Primary falsifiers (exit!=0 at :62, 401 at :50) are soundly guarded, but the secondary leak-guard on the refused 2nd-init greps the dead prefix 'rim_' instead of the actual 'rk_' minted-key prefix, and the other disjunct only matches init-1's exact plaintext -- a newly-minted leaked key on a refused 2nd init passes silently. Vacuous test assertion, not a story defect.

sources: dossier=asset ('trace lineage to consumers' sourced to a single 2026-06-08 corpus-bootstrap artifact mention, never corroborated or revisited in transcript; CLI surface entry is a separate 2026-05-15 artifact naming only an unqualified 'asset lineage' verb); code=lib/control/controlapi/assets.go (no consumer-lineage route), lib/control/controlapi/lineage.go (claim endpoints are ancestors-only, no claim-descendants/consumers route), cmd/rimsky/cli/asset.go:173-227 (asset lineage CLI calls GetClaimAncestors -- upstream direction)
note: User ruling 2026-07-17 (design-call resolved): 'trace its lineage to consumers' is not a rimsky capability — rimsky has no first-class consumer notion (external substrate readers invisible; ecosystem-level consumer tracking is the OpenLineage export's job). Story rewritten: capability is the lineage trace rimsky delivers (forward run-level walk); consumer-impact reasoning flipped to the 'so that' motivation; lineage acceptance clause + falsifier added (both previously missing). Proof lands with the Phase 2 story-proof sweep.

sources: dossier=cascade (CEL when: predicate + signal-blind delivery, 2026-06-10/06-18 transcript); test=cascade_signal_blind_e2e_test.go:296-328 (only tag-present asserted at :325-326), loop_counter_cap_e2e_test.go:74-105 (suppression direction proven elsewhere in the suite)
note: Acceptance requires the tag filter to both fire-when-present and not-fire-when-absent; this story's own named proof (testCascadeTerminalSuccessWithTagFilterPerSender) only asserts the fire-when-present leg. The suppression behavior is real (proven by an unrelated test), so this is a proof-coverage gap local to this story, not a defect in the cascade engine or the story's prose.
